# @arki/math

> Math for TypeScript, depending only on `@arki/failure`: exact `Decimal` and `Rational`, plus float helpers. Not money, symbolic algebra or expression parsing.

Build decimals from strings. Give every inexact step a scale and a rounding mode.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/math`: the whole numeric toolkit from one import, except `linear-algebra`, whose short names would clash. `Complex`, `ConvergenceError`, `Decimal`, `DivisionByZeroError`, `E`, `EmptyDataError`, `ExtrapolationConvergenceError`, `IntegrationConvergenceError`, `InvalidArgumentError`, `InvalidNumber`, `MATH_ERROR_CODES`, `MATH_PARSE_FAILURES`; and 299 more.
- `@arki/math/errors`: Parsers return, builders throw. `ConvergenceError`, `DivisionByZeroError`, `EmptyDataError`, `InvalidArgumentError`, `InvalidNumber`, `MATH_ERROR_CODES`, `MATH_PARSE_FAILURES`, `MathError`, `NotPositiveDefiniteError`, `NumberFormatError`, `NumberOutOfRange`, `NumericRangeError`; and 6 more.
- `@arki/math/rounding`: One rounding vocabulary for the whole package. `ROUNDING_MODES`, `isRoundingMode`; types `RoundingMode`.
- `@arki/math/number`: Helpers for ordinary JS numbers: the fast, approximate 80% case (UI, geometry, charts). `approxEqual`, `assertFinite`, `clamp`, `inRange`, `inverseLerp`, `lerp`, `linspace`, `range`, `remap`, `round`, `roundTo`, `roundToSignificant`; and 2 more.
- `@arki/math/integer`: Integer and number-theory helpers with matching `number` and `bigint` overloads. `combinations`, `digitSum`, `divisors`, `divmod`, `factorial`, `fibonacci`, `fromBase`, `gcd`, `isEven`, `isOdd`, `isPrime`, `lcm`; and 5 more.
- `@arki/math/decimal`: exact decimals with a retained scale. `Decimal`, `decimal`, `isDecimal`; types `DecimalInput`, `RoundingMode`, `ScaleOptions`.
- `@arki/math/decimal-math`: Roots, logarithms and exponentials on `Decimal`. `E`, `PI`, `cbrt`, `exp`, `ln`, `log`, `log10`, `log2`, `nthRoot`, `pow`, `sqrt`.
- `@arki/math/rational`: exact fractions on `bigint`. `Rational`, `isRational`, `ratio`; types `IntegerInput`, `MixedNumber`, `RationalInput`, `RoundingMode`, `ScaleOptions`.
- `@arki/math/stats`: Descriptive statistics over plain JS numbers, or over `Decimal` values. `QUANTILE_METHODS`, `confidenceInterval`, `correlation`, `exponentialRegression`, `linearRegression`, `logarithmicRegression`, `marginOfError`, `mean`, `median`, `minMax`, `mode`, `percentile`; and 34 more.
- `@arki/math/distributions`: Probability distributions and the special functions behind them, over plain JS numbers. `MAX_NONCENTRALITY`, `beta`, `betaLn`, `binomial`, `chiSquare`, `erf`, `erfInv`, `erfc`, `exponential`, `fisherF`, `gamma`, `gammaLn`; and 10 more.
- `@arki/math/format`: Presentation helpers built on `Intl.NumberFormat`. `RUNTIME_LOCALE`, `createFormatter`, `formatCompact`, `formatCurrency`, `formatFileSize`, `formatNumber`, `formatPercent`; types `CompactOptions`, `CurrencyOptions`, `FileSizeOptions`, `FormatOptions`, `FormatValue`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/math/parse`: Locale-aware number parsing. `localeNumberSymbols`, `parseDecimal`, `parseNumber`; types `LocaleNumberSymbols`, `ParseOptions`, `ParseSymbols`.
- `@arki/math/random`: Random numbers that behave the same on every JavaScript runtime. `createRandom`, `pick`, `random`, `randomBool`, `randomFloat`, `randomInt`, `sample`, `shuffle`; types `Random`.
- `@arki/math/fluent`: Immutable fluent wrapper for ordinary JS numbers, the counterpart of `str()` in `@arki/string`. `NumberValue`, `num`.
- `@arki/math/words`: Numbers as words and ordinals — the part of Laravel's `Number::spell` / `ordinal` that `Intl` never shipped. `en`, `enGB`, `formatOrdinal`, `spellNumber`, `spellOrdinal`, `thousandsGroups`; types `Gender`, `NumberWordsLocale`, `OrdinalOptions`, `SpellOptions`, `WordsContext`.
- `@arki/math/words/de`: German number words (long scale: Milliarde = 10^9, Billion = 10^12). `de`.
- `@arki/math/words/es`: Spanish number words (long scale: mil millones = 10^9, billón = 10^12). `es`.
- `@arki/math/words/fr`: French number words in traditional (pre-1990) orthography: spaces between groups, `et` only for 21–61 and 71, `quatre-vingts` / `deux cents` take an `s` only when nothing follows them. `fr`.
- `@arki/math/words/it`: Italian number words (@arki/math/words/it). `it`.
- `@arki/math/words/ro`: Romanian number words (@arki/math/words/ro). `ro`.
- `@arki/math/units`: Unit conversion across twenty-two categories. `convert`, `convertExact`, `formatUnit`, `isUnit`, `joinUnits`, `splitUnits`, `unitCategory`, `unitsOf`; types `AngleUnit`, `AreaUnit`, `DataRateUnit`, `DataUnit`; and 24 more.
- `@arki/math/finance`: Time-value-of-money helpers that follow the conventions of Excel and Google Sheets, so formulas port over directly. `amortizationSchedule`, `compoundInterest`, `effectiveRate`, `futureValue`, `internalRateOfReturn`, `netPresentValue`, `nominalRate`, `payment`, `periodsToReach`, `presentValue`, `simpleInterest`; types `AmortizationRow`; and 5 more.
- `@arki/math/finance/float`: Time-value-of-money on plain `number`: the float layer of @arki/math/finance. `amortizationSchedule`, `compoundInterest`, `effectiveRate`, `futureValue`, `internalRateOfReturn`, `netPresentValue`, `nominalRate`, `payment`, `periodsToReach`, `presentValue`; types `AmortizationRow`, `AnnuityOptions`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/math/roots`: Real roots of a function of one real variable, `f: (x: number) => number`, on float64. `RootConvergenceError`, `bisect`, `findRoot`, `findRoots`, `newton`; types `FindRootsOptions`, `NewtonOptions`, `RealFunction`, `RootOptions`, `RootResult`.
- `@arki/math/integrate`: Definite integrals of a one-variable function. `IntegrationConvergenceError`, `integrate`; types `IntegrateOptions`, `IntegrationMethod`, `IntegrationResult`, `RealFunction`.
- `@arki/math/differentiate`: Numerical derivatives and limits of a one-variable function. `ExtrapolationConvergenceError`, `derivative`, `limit`; types `ExtrapolationOptions`, `ExtrapolationResult`, `LimitOptions`, `LimitSide`, `RealFunction`.
- `@arki/math/geometry`: Plane and solid geometry on ordinary JS numbers. `circle`, `circleSector`, `cone`, `cube`, `cuboid`, `cylinder`, `distance`, `ellipse`, `frustum`, `isPythagoreanTriple`, `midpoint`, `polygonArea`; and 25 more.
- `@arki/math/linear-algebra`: Dense linear algebra over plain float64 numbers. `angleBetween`, `choleskyDecompose`, `choleskySolve`, `conditionNumber`, `cross`, `determinant`, `dot`, `eigenDecompose`, `eigenvalues`, `identity`, `inverse`, `leastSquares`; and 31 more.
- `@arki/math/complex`: Complex numbers on plain JS floats (`number`). `Complex`, `complex`, `isComplex`, `parseComplex`; types `ComplexInput`, `Polar`.
- `@arki/math/polynomial`: Polynomials over plain JS floats, stored as coefficient arrays. `addPolynomials`, `cubicRoots`, `evaluatePolynomial`, `multiplyPolynomials`, `polynomialDerivative`, `polynomialRoots`, `quadraticRoots`; types `Coefficients`, `CubicRoots`, `QuadraticRoots`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- Exact types throw `RoundingNecessaryError` until you pass a mode.
- Nothing returns `NaN`; failures are `MathError` with a code.
- Values stop at 10 000 digits; no bigint passes 18 000 digits (Hermes V1 limit), so roots reach about 9 000 digits, `exp`/`ln`/`log` about 8 900, and `factorial` n = 5 450.
